description_prefix: resource call with a formal embedded in an unmodeled expression
why: On the card's base (5355998d) this rd_kafka_buf_read_* macro line reported `call to uncontracted function `__bswap_16`` plus unknown_alias leaves; the card's header-body route decides __bswap_16 and the call classifier then reports this leaf instead. On main, W44-ASSIGNMENT-DESTINATION-SUFFIX-PLACE refuses the line's sub-object store at the lexical gate before the call is classified, and already removed the __bswap_16 leaf and the misnamed-alias leaves (they are among the 169 overlap leaves). With the statement refused earlier, the replacement leaf never arises on the combined tree; the function stays Unknown with the gate's refusals.
